question: Where was the injured leopard finally treated?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Rohtak Zoo".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As we see the last line of 3rd paragraph it is clearly mentioned that "The leopard was first taken to a treatment centre in Sultanpur National Park and then to **Rohtak zoo**"
 
• With reference to this line, the correct answer is option no 4.
